# Borderless table shading at whole-twip origin phases

`control.docx` is original OPC/XML generated by
`tools/borderless_fill_phase_fixture.py`. It contains 60 floating borderless
tables and 75 empty shaded cells: all 15 whole-twip phases, independently varied
x/y origins, widths 593/600/607 twips, heights 113/120/127 twips, and adjacent
293/307-twip red/blue columns. There is no text, font program, theme, media,
template content or copied artwork.

The exact owned copy was opened with the reference-opening helper. Sky observations
confirmed the reference application's Saved state, one page, and 100%/200% zoom. Pointer and table
handles were cleared before the two captures. `reference.json` records
source/case/crop/raw hashes and independent paper origins. The crops contain
only our authored page. Further reference zoom-dialog inputs did not visibly apply;
no fractional-zoom native reference is asserted.

`tools/record_borderless_fill_phase.py` measures each source-positioned region
using color dominance and a luminance midpoint. Tests reproduce all 150 native
bounds from the retained crops and compare the current canvas to them. JPEG
chroma is not an exact RGB, antialiasing or opacity oracle.

The reference application rounds a borderless table's device origin before advancing through its
grid; an absolute far-edge snap can shorten a 593-twip cell. Cumulative grid
edges keep adjacent columns joined. Absolute and frame-relative constraints
also govern vertical edges; rounding each row's own height independently opens
gaps in existing native merged-shading controls. All rows, including unfilled
ones, therefore contribute to the page's table frame. Source coordinates,
explicit shading reserves and parent clips remain separate from projection.

ECMA-376 Part 1 §§17.4.32 (`shd`), 17.4.48 (`tblGrid`), 17.4.57 (`tblpPr`),
17.4.80 (`trHeight`), and 17.18.87 (table layout) define the source geometry.
The format does not prescribe screen raster rounding. This is observed reference
display compatibility, not a normative-spec contradiction or full-page equivalence
certification.

Regenerate in an empty folder with `python tools/borderless_fill_phase_fixture.py
<folder>`; expected source SHA-256 is
`5aaaa233c308404dc75c90154c8e19be2392da8618484519aefc56353e71794c`.
